verdicts.reason: In A, the hand holding the heart stays intact, but it is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail. The second headline breaks badly, leaving 'THE' stranded on its own line, and that headline competes with the main one. The contact text is unreadably small and squeezed against the right edge, and the URL floats on its own with no group. B has the same orphaned 'THE' and tiny contact text, and it is worse: the heart has been pulled away from the hand and the hand is a cropped grey shape, which breaks the key image. Its URL also sits at the top edge without lining up with anything.
